summary: Frontend-only verification of the MobileBrandRow pills fix under Split Systems hero. All spec requirements pass: 4 pills with correct testids/hrefs, brand names + 'See Prices' + gold accent + arrow, min-width 188px (Mitsubishi pills auto-wider), no text truncation (scrollWidth==clientWidth, text-overflow: clip), 'Mitsubishi Heavy Industries' shortened to 'Mitsubishi Heavy' in display while URL preserved. Swipeable (scroll container scrollWidth=897 vs viewport 375). ~2 pills visible on mobile (1 fully + 2nd at 93%; 3rd offscreen at x=400). Right-edge click on pill navigates (whole pill is link). Desktop 1440: all 4 pills visible & centered (sm:justify-center). Regression brand-pricing-nav 4 cards intact, no 'undefined'. All 4 /split-systems/{slug} pages render.

issues: Rinnai pill's right edge is at x=388 (13px past 375 viewport), so strictly only 1 pill is 100% visible; 2nd pill is 93% visible. Matches spec's '2 to 2.5 pills' intent but not a strict '2 fully visible'. Consider slightly reducing pill min-width or horizontal padding if strict 2-full-pills is required.

critical_code_review_comments: MobileBrandRow now clean and self-contained; SHORT_BRAND map keeps URLs untouched — good separation of display vs routing.
The scroll container uses -mx-6 + px-6 to bleed to edges — works well; scrollbar hidden per platform.
